statements.t: The shareholder letter, supplemental financial tables, and forward-looking guidance are available on the company’s website at www.devonenergy.com .
Supported by free cash flow and the Eagle Ford sale proceeds, the company plans to retire an additional $1.5 billion of long-term debt, reaching its $9 billion gross debt target in early 2027.
The company expects share repurchases to step up to more than $1 billion in the fourth quarter and to rise further in 2027, fueled in part by the net proceeds from the Eagle Ford sale.

The company now expects approximately $700 million of average synergies in 2027, up from $600 million, and continues to expect at least $1.0 billion of annual pre-tax run-rate synergies by year-end 2027.
The company is reaffirming its full-year 2026 production and capital guidance with the Eagle Ford included through closing.

On a pro forma basis, adjusted for the Eagle Ford sale, the company expects 2027 oil production of approximately 525,000 barrels per day and total production of approximately 1,600,000 Boe per day on total capital of approximately $5.3 billion.
Additional details of Devon’s forward-looking guidance are available on the company’s website at www.devonenergy.com .
The company’s third-quarter conference call will be held at 10:00 a.m.
